page.content:
Communications officer of the TOS Enterprise.

How Nyota Uhura connects

  • Series: Star Trek: The Original Series — Uhura is the TOS communications officer.
  • Faction: Enterprise crew — Uhura is communications officer of the TOS crew.

What is Nyota Uhura?

Nyota Uhura is the communications officer whose bridge presence, linguistics, and later expanded first name made her a lasting Starfleet figure.

Key threads lead to Star Trek: The Original Series and Enterprise crew.
